Questions and Answers for BLAZE007

Which Currency is Accepted?

  • AUD (Australian Dollar) is the only accepted currency.
  • Payment gateway methods also support Visa Master CreditCard; cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, USDT, Ethereum, and others



How to Create an Account?

 You will need:

  • An Australian phone number.
  • A bank account, BSB number, and PayID under your name.
  •  To get started:

1. Click the “REGISTER” button on the homepage.

2. You will receive a verification code on your phone number.

3. Once registered, you can top up your account by clicking “DEPOSIT” or withdraw funds by clicking “WITHDRAW”.


  • IMPORTANT : If a player is found to have registered with fraudulent details, we have the right to withhold withdrawal services and deactivate the account.



What Should I Do If I Can’t Receive the Verification Code?

  •  Ensure you are using an active and valid Australian phone number.
  • The maximum number of verification code requests is 2 times per day. If exceeded, you must wait 24 hours before trying again.
  •  Make sure your phone can receive SMS.
  • Note: For security reasons, we cannot assist with registration or OTP verification codes. If issues persist, contact our customer service for clarification.



Can I Register Multiple Accounts?

  •  No. Multiple account registrations are strictly prohibited. Violating this policy will result in account restrictions and the forfeiture of any associated benefits.


What Are the Deposit and Withdrawal Limits?

  •  Minimum deposit: AUD 5.
  • Minimum withdrawal: AUD 20 (excluding applied bonuses).
  • Deposits for SLOT games require a x1 rollover on the total bet.
  •  Withdrawals are limited 10 times per day.


  • IMPORTANT : please DO NOT USE ANY HISTORY / SAVE PAYEE TO MAKE PAYMENT, as this may result in the funds being transferred to an account that does not belong to us. Please manually enter the PayID. If you do not follow our guidelines , we will not be held responsible.



If I Still Have a Balance, Can I Make Another Deposit?

  •  To avoid confusion with bonus rules:

1. Play and wager your points after each deposit and bonus acquisition.

2. Once your points fall below AUD 1 or after withdrawal, you can make another deposit.

  •  Note: Before submitting your next deposit, click “Clear Balance” to ensure your credit does not combine with other bonuses, as this may affect your withdrawal limit.



What Are Rollover, Turnover, and Winover?

  •  Rollover: Total bet of your credit in the game = (Deposit Amount).
  • Turnover: Minimum withdrawal / final remaining credit, or total bet of your credit in the game = (Deposit + Bonus).
  •  Winover: Total win of your credit = (Deposit + Bonus).



Why Do Normal Deposits Have a Rollover?

  •  All normal deposits have a default x1 rollover to prevent misuse, such as depositing funds without playing and immediately withdrawing. This ensures we can provide better service to all customers.



Can I Combine Multiple Bonuses at the Same Time?

  •  No. You cannot apply for multiple promotions, free credits, bonuses, refunds, commissions, or angpao simultaneously. Combining bonuses may override withdrawal rules, resulting in forfeiture of the bonus.



Why Do Gaming Platforms Sometimes Disappear?

  • Gaming platforms may temporarily disappear for maintenance to improve the gaming environment. Once maintenance is complete, the platform and your credits will be restored.


What Should I Do If My Credits Disappear During Game Maintenance?

  •  Don’t worry. Credits are temporarily removed during maintenance and will be automatically restored once maintenance is complete.



I’ve Met the Rollover Requirements, Why Can’t I Withdraw?

  •  After leaving all games, wait a few minutes for the system to update your rollover status. If issues persist, contact LiveChat for assistance.



Verify Withdrawal Rules

  •  You can view the withdrawal rules under the “Balance” section in your Wallet.
  • If you’ve claimed a bonus, check the Bonus Details for specific conditions.
  • ⚠Important: If the withdrawal conditions for a bonus are not ideal, inform us before entering the game to cancel the bonus. Requests to cancel after starting the game will be denied.



How to Find My Referral Link?

  •  On the website or app, scroll down and click the “COPY REFERRAL LINK” option.



How to Earn Weekly Passive Income?

  •  Share your referral link with friends to earn commission. The more friends you refer, the more passive income you can earn.


If you have further questions, contact us via LiveChat anytime, 24/7.

Thank you for your support.



BLAZE007 General Terms & Conditions apply.
